theorems.name: request_starts_pulse
theorems.doc: (S) A request while idle drives the relay high now, until 500 ms later.
theorems.statement:
theorem request_starts_pulse (p : Bool) (now : Std.U64) (hn : now.val < 2 ^ 63) :
    ∃ u, step { phase := .Idle, pending := p } .Request now
        = ok ({ phase := .Pulse u, pending := false }, { relay := some true, timer_at := some u }) ∧
      u.val = now.val + 500
theorems.proof:
theorem request_starts_pulse (p : Bool) (now : Std.U64) (hn : now.val < 2 ^ 63) :
    ∃ u, step { phase := .Idle, pending := p } .Request now
        = ok ({ phase := .Pulse u, pending := false }, { relay := some true, timer_at := some u }) ∧
      u.val = now.val + 500 := by
  have hv := sat64_val now PULSE_MS
  rw [pulse_val] at hv
  refine ⟨core.num.U64.saturating_add now PULSE_MS, by simp [step, start, lift], ?_⟩
  rw [hv]; omega

theorems.name: pulse_ends_low
theorems.doc: (S) The relay is never left high: at the pulse's end it goes low, and the pause (2 s) starts; a waiting request stays waiting.
theorems.statement:
theorem pulse_ends_low (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) (h : u.val ≤ now.val) (hn : now.val < 2 ^ 63) :
    ∃ n, step { phase := .Pulse u, pending := p } .Timer now
        = ok ({ phase := .Pause n, pending := p }, { relay := some false, timer_at := some n }) ∧
      n.val = now.val + 2000
theorems.proof:
theorem pulse_ends_low (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) (h : u.val ≤ now.val) (hn : now.val < 2 ^ 63) :
    ∃ n, step { phase := .Pulse u, pending := p } .Timer now
        = ok ({ phase := .Pause n, pending := p }, { relay := some false, timer_at := some n }) ∧
      n.val = now.val + 2000 := by
  have hv := sat64_val now PAUSE_MS
  rw [pause_val] at hv
  have : ¬ now < u := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨core.num.U64.saturating_add now PAUSE_MS, by simp [step, lift, this], ?_⟩
  rw [hv]; omega

theorems.name: pulse_lasts_its_time
theorems.doc: (S) A pulse is never cut short: before its end a timer changes nothing.
theorems.statement:
theorem pulse_lasts_its_time (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) (h : now.val < u.val) :
    step { phase := .Pulse u, pending := p } .Timer now = ok ({ phase := .Pulse u, pending := p }, NONE)
theorems.proof:
theorem pulse_lasts_its_time (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) (h : now.val < u.val) :
    step { phase := .Pulse u, pending := p } .Timer now = ok ({ phase := .Pulse u, pending := p }, NONE) := by
  have : now < u := by scalar_tac
  simp [step, this]

theorems.name: busy_request_coalesced
theorems.doc: (S) Requests during a pulse or its pause are coalesced: the relay is not touched, nothing is armed, one request waits (as upstream's `Signal`).
theorems.statement:
theorem busy_request_coalesced (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) :
    step { phase := .Pulse u, pending := p } .Request now = ok ({ phase := .Pulse u, pending := true }, NONE) ∧
    step { phase := .Pause u, pending := p } .Request now = ok ({ phase := .Pause u, pending := true }, NONE)
theorems.proof:
theorem busy_request_coalesced (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) :
    step { phase := .Pulse u, pending := p } .Request now = ok ({ phase := .Pulse u, pending := true }, NONE) ∧
    step { phase := .Pause u, pending := p } .Request now = ok ({ phase := .Pause u, pending := true }, NONE) := by
  constructor <;> simp [step]

theorems.name: next_pulse_after_pause
theorems.doc: (S) After a pause, the next pulse starts only once the pause is over, and only for a waiting request.
theorems.statement:
theorem next_pulse_after_pause (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) :
    step { phase := .Pause u, pending := p } .Timer now ⦃ r =>
      r.2.relay = some true → u.val ≤ now.val ∧ p = true ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem next_pulse_after_pause (u now : Std.U64) (p : Bool) :
    step { phase := .Pause u, pending := p } .Timer now ⦃ r =>
      r.2.relay = some true → u.val ≤ now.val ∧ p = true ⦄ := by
  by_cases h : now.val < u.val
  · have : now < u := by scalar_tac
    simp [step, this, NONE]
  · have : ¬ now < u := by scalar_tac
    cases p <;> simp [step, start, lift, this, NONE] <;> omega

theorems.name: high_only_starting
theorems.doc: (S) The relay goes high only to start a pulse: for a request while idle, or at the end of a pause with a request waiting.
theorems.statement:
theorem high_only_starting (v : Vrata) (ev : Event) (now : Std.U64) :
    step v ev now ⦃ r => r.2.relay = some true →
      (v.phase = .Idle ∧ ev = .Request) ∨ (∃ u, v.phase = .Pause u ∧ ev = .Timer ∧ u.val ≤ now.val ∧ v.pending = true) ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem high_only_starting (v : Vrata) (ev : Event) (now : Std.U64) :
    step v ev now ⦃ r => r.2.relay = some true →
      (v.phase = .Idle ∧ ev = .Request) ∨ (∃ u, v.phase = .Pause u ∧ ev = .Timer ∧ u.val ≤ now.val ∧ v.pending = true) ⦄ := by
  rcases v with ⟨ph, pe⟩
  rcases ph with _ | u | u <;> cases ev
  · simp [step, start, lift]
  · simp [step, NONE]
  · simp [step, NONE]
  · by_cases h : now.val < u.val
    · have : now < u := by scalar_tac
      simp [step, this, NONE]
    · have : ¬ now < u := by scalar_tac
      simp [step, lift, this]
  · simp [step, NONE]
  · by_cases h : now.val < u.val
    · have : now < u := by scalar_tac
      simp [step, this, NONE]
    · have : ¬ now < u := by scalar_tac
      cases pe <;> simp [step, start, lift, this, NONE] <;> omega

Event.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Event where
| Request : Event
| Timer : Event
Event.upstream_note: a request (butn's SIGNAL.signal) or a timer firing

NONE.kernel_code: const NONE: Act = Act { relay: None, timer_at: None };
NONE.lean:
@[global_simps, irreducible]
def NONE : Act := { relay := none, timer_at := none }
NONE.upstream_note: port-only: the step that changes nothing

Phase.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Phase where
| Idle : Phase
| Pulse : Std.U64 → Phase
| Pause : Std.U64 → Phase
Phase.upstream_note: where vrata_task's loop is: waiting on the signal, in the pulse, in the pause

start.lean:
def start (now : Std.U64) : Result (Vrata × Act) := do
  let «until» ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_add now PULSE_MS)
  ok ({ phase := (Phase.Pulse «until»), pending := false },
    { relay := (some true), timer_at := (some «until») })

Act.lean:
structure Act where
  relay : Option Bool
  timer_at : Option Std.U64
Act.upstream_note: the relay level set and the next timer armed

PAUSE_MS.upstream_note: Timer::after_secs(2): the pause after a pulse

step.lean:
def step (v : Vrata) (ev : Event) (now : Std.U64) : Result (Vrata × Act) := do
  match v.phase with
  | Phase.Idle =>
    match ev with
    | Event.Request => start now
    | Event.Timer => ok (v, NONE)
  | Phase.Pulse «until» =>
    match ev with
    | Event.Request => ok ({ phase := v.phase, pending := true }, NONE)
    | Event.Timer =>
      if now < «until»
      then ok (v, NONE)
      else
        let next ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_add now PAUSE_MS)
        ok ({ v with phase := (Phase.Pause next) },
          { relay := (some false), timer_at := (some next) })
  | Phase.Pause «until» =>
    match ev with
    | Event.Request => ok ({ phase := v.phase, pending := true }, NONE)
    | Event.Timer =>
      if now < «until»
      then ok (v, NONE)
      else
        if v.pending
        then start now
        else ok ({ phase := Phase.Idle, pending := false }, NONE)
step.upstream_note: vrata_task's loop and butn's signal as one event-driven state machine

Vrata.lean:
structure Vrata where
  phase : Phase
  pending : Bool
Vrata.upstream_note: the loop's phase and the Signal's pending flag
